accessibility.method: automated semantic, keyboard-entry, exact-font and responsive regression; not an independent WCAG certification

failure.normalizedRootCause: A pointer-driven 3D transform on the containing .q-panel continued while the pointer targeted an interactive descendant. The transformed panel moved the visible save control away from the already proven trusted pointer coordinate, so elementFromPoint hit the surrounding calculator layout.
failure.scope: Indicator Detail, full motion, interactive descendant inside a pointer-tilted panel
failure.siblingEvidence: Firefox and WebKit Indicator Detail passed; every other completed browser shard passed. All specialist workflows were green.

correction.behavior: When pointermove originates from a button, link, form control, role-button, role-link or data-action descendant, reset the parent panel tilt to zero and return. Magnetic control motion remains available on the control itself.
correction.testPolicy: No retries, no forced clicks, no timeout inflation and no denominator reduction. Rerun Chromium, Firefox and WebKit Indicator Detail plus its desktop/mobile accessibility shard before one complete acceptance matrix.

nextAction: Run the focused 216-browser and 2-accessibility Indicator Detail correction gate, then run one complete immutable 1,944-browser and 54-accessibility pre-design acceptance matrix.
